item.title: LEGENDARY RAJPUT HISTORY - Veerta, Jauhar Aur Balidaan Ki Kahani | Rajveer Sir On TRS
item.description:
Rajveer Sir joins The Ranveer Show हिंदी for legendary Rajput history — veerta, jauhar, and balidaan. Oral history of valor and sacrifice that shaped North Indian martial identity.
Hindi long-form keeps martial memory alive outside textbooks — Rajput veerta/jauhar as identity performance, not museum fact. Craft: BeerBiceps oral-history mode turns legend into listen-through culture for the diaspora ear.

item.title: Ep 452: Harini Nagendra is Woolgathering and Ground Truthing
item.description:
The city and nature do not need to be at odds with each other; and dreamers can be doers. Harini Nagendra joins Amit Varma in episode 452 of The Seen and the Unseen to discuss her work in ecology, urban sustainability, detective fiction and the art of managing multitudes.
Why this sharpens your taste: Nagendra’s move is “ground truthing” — refuse abstract green talk until you’ve counted actual canopy, birds, and street-level tradeoffs. Craft move: pair woolgathering (imagination) with measurement so Indian urban ecology isn’t vibes.
Apple Podcasts: https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/ep-452-harini-nagendra-is-woolgathering-and-ground/id1190896090?i=1000788228084
